name: Glitch in the Matrix
description: An umbrella term, popularized by the 1999 film 'The Matrix', for first-person experiences in which reality appears momentarily to malfunction — déjà vu, objects appearing or disappearing, duplicate strangers, sudden timeline mismatches — and which the experiencer interprets as evidence that the world is a computer simulation.

aliases.name: Simulation glitch
aliases.meaning: framed in terms of the simulation hypothesis

origin: A globally distributed, internet-mediated phenomenon, most heavily reported in English-speaking online communities (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia) but with active counterparts in many languages.
